translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Alif-Laam-Meem
romi log qareeb ki sarzameen mein maghloob hogaye hain ,
aur woh apney maghloob honey kay baad unqareeb ghalib aajayen gay .
chand hi salon mein ! sara ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai , pehlay bhi aur baad mein bhi . aur uss din emaan walay Allah ki di hoi fatah say khush hon gay .
woh jiss ko chahta hai , fatah deta hai , aur wohi sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .
yeh Allah ka kiya huwa wada hai . Allah apney waday kay khilaf nahi kerta , lekin aksar log nahi jantay .
woh dunyawi zindagi kay sirf zahiri rukh ko jantay hain , aur aakhirat kay baaray mein unn ka haal yeh hai kay woh uss say bilkul ghafil hain .

bhala kiya enhon ney apney dilon mein ghor nahi kiya-? Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan pai janey wali cheezon ko baghair kissi bar-haq maqsad kay aur koi miyaad muqarrar kiye baghair peda nahi kerdiya    aur boht say log hain kay apney perwerdigar say jaa milney kay munkir hain .

kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain , takay woh yeh dekhtay kay unn say pehlay jo log thay , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa-? woh taqat mein inn say ziyada mazboot thay , aur unhon ney zameen ko bhi jota tha , aur jitna inn logon  ney ussay abad kiya hai , uss say ziyada unhon ney uss ko abad kiya tha , aur unn kay paas unn kay payghumber khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye thay ! chunacheh Allah to aisa nahi tha kay unn per zulm keray , lekin woh khud apni janon per zulm kertay rahey .
phir jinn logon  ney burai ki thi , unn ka anjam bhi bura hi huwa , kiyonkay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya tha , aur woh unn ka mazaq uraya kertay thay .
Allah hi makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , aur wohi uss ko dobara peda keray ga ,   phir tum sabb uss kay paas wapis bula liye jao gay .
aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz mujrim log na-umeed hojayen gay .
aur unhon ney jinn ko Allah ka shareek maan rakha tha , unn mein say koi unn ka sirfarishi nahi hoga , aur khud yeh log apney maaney huye shareekon say munkir hojayen gay .
aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss roz log mukhtalif qismon mein butt jayen gay .
chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye thay , unn ko to jannat mein aesi khushiyan di jayen gi jo unn kay chehron say phooti parr rahi hon gi .
aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya tha aur humari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , to aesay logon  ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .
lehaza Allah ki tasbeeh kero uss waqt bhi jab tumharay paas shaam aati hai , aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per subha tuloo hoti hai ,
aur ussi ki hamd hoti hai aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi aur sooraj dhalney kay waqt bhi ( uss ki tasbeeh kero ) aur uss waqt bhi jab tum per zohar ka waqt aata hai .

woh jandaar ko bey jaan say nikal lata hai , aur bey jaan ko jandaar say nikal leta hai ,   aur woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . aur issi tarah tum ko ( qabron say ) nikal liya jaye ga .
aur uss ki ( qudrat ki ) aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tum ko mitti say peda kiya , phir tum dekhtay hi dekhtay insan ban ker ( zameen mein ) phelay parray ho .

aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay uss ney tumharay liye tum hi mein say biwiyan peda ken , takay tum unn kay paas jaker sukoon hasil kero , aur tumharay darmiyan mohabbat aur rehmat kay jazbaat rakh diye .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam letay hain .
aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa aasmano aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur tumhari zabanon aur rangon ka ikhtilaf bhi hai . yaqeenan iss mein danish mandon kay liye bari nishaniyan hain .
aur uss ki nishaniyon ka aik hissa tumhara raat aur din kay waqt sona aur Allah ka fazal talash kerna hai .   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo baat suntay hon .

aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh tumhen bijli ki chamak dikhata hai jiss say darr bhi lagta hai , aur umeed bhi hoti hai ,   aur aasman say paani barsata hai , jiss kay zariye woh zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshta hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam letay hain .
aur uss ki aik nishani yeh hai kay aasman aur zameen uss kay hukum say qaeem hain . phir jab woh aik pukar dey ker tumhen zameen say bulaye ga to tum foran nikal parro gay .
aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi hain sabb ussi ki milkiyat hain . sabb ussi kay hukum kay tabey hain

aur wohi hai jo makhlooq ki ibtida kerta hai , phir ussay dobara peda keray ga , aur yeh kaam uss kay liye boht aasaan hai . aur ussi ki sabb say oonchi shaan hai , aasmano mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .

woh tumhen khud tumharay andar say aik misal deta hai . hum ney jo rizq tumhen diya hai , kiya tumharay ghulamon mein say koi uss mein tumhara shareek hai kay uss rizq mein tumhara darja unn kay barabar ho ( aur ) tum unn ghulamon say wesay hi dartay ho jaisay aapas mein aik doosray say dartay ho-?   hum issi tarah dalaeel unn logon  kay liye khol khol ker biyan kertay hain jo aqal say kaam len .

lekin zalim log kissi ilm kay baghair apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal parray hain . abb uss shaks ko kon hidayat dey sakta hai jissay Allah ney gumrah kerdiya ho ,   aur aesay logon  ka koi madadgaar nahi hoga .

lehaza tum yak soo ho ker apna rukh iss deen ki taraf qaeem rakho . Allah ki banai hoi uss fitrat per chalo jiss per uss ney tamam logon  ko peda kiya hai   Allah ki takhleeq mein koi tabdeeli nahi laee jasakti ,   yehi bilkul seedha raasta hai , lekin aksar log nahi jantay

. ( fitrat ki perwi ) iss tarah ( kero ) kay tum ney ussi ( Allah ) say lo laga rakhi ho , aur uss say dartay raho , aur namaz qaeem kero , aur unn logon  kay sath shamil naa ho jo shirk ka irtikab kertay hain ,
woh jinhon ney apney deen ko tukrray tukrray kerliya , aur mukhtalif firqon mein butt gaye . her giroh apney apney tareeqay per magan hai .

aur jab logon  ko koi takleef choo jati hai to woh apney perwerdigar say lo laga ker ussi ko pukartay hain , phir jab woh apni taraf say unhen kissi rehmat ka zaiqa chakha deta hai , to unn mein say kuch log yakayak apney perwerdigar kay sath shirk kernay lagtay hain ,
takay hum ney unhen jo kuch diya tha , uss ki nashukri keren . acha ! kuch mazay urra lo , phir woh waqt door nahi jab tumhen sabb pata chal jaye ga .
bhala kiya hum ney unn per koi aesi daleel nazil ki hai jo uss shirk ka irtikab kernay ko kehti ho jo yeh Allah kay sath kertay rahey hain-?

aur jab hum logon  ko rehmat ka maza chakhatay hain to woh iss/uss per itra jatay hain , aur agar unhen khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say koi burai phonch jaye to zara si dair mein woh mayyus honey lagtay hain .

kiya unhon ney yeh nahi dekha kay Allah jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq kushada ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahye ) tang ker deta hai .   iss mein yaqeenan unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo emaan layen .
lehaza tum rishta daar ko uss ka haq do , aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi .   jo log Allah ki khushnoodi chahtay hain , unn kay liye yeh behtar hai , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

aur yeh jo tum sood detay ho takay woh logon  kay maal mein shamil ho ker barh jaye to woh Allah kay nazdeek barhta nahi hai ,   aur jo zakat tum Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay iraday say detay ho , to jo log bhi aisa kertay hain woh hain jo ( apney maal ko ) kaee guna barha letay hain .

Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir uss ney tumhen rizq diya , phir woh tumhen moat deta hai , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . jinn ko tum ney Allah ka shareek maana huwa hai , kiya unn mein say koi hai jo inn mein say koi kaam kerta ho-? pak hai woh aur boht baala o bartar uss shirk say jiss ka irtikab yeh log kertay hain .

logon  ney apney haathon jo kamai ki , uss ki wajeh say khushki aur tari mein fasad phela ,   takay unhon ney jo kaam kiye hain Allah unn mein say kuch ka maza unhen chakhaye , shayad woh baaz aajayen .
. ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) kaho kay :  zameen mein chal phir ker dekho kay jo log pehlay guzray hain , unn ka kaisa anjam huwa . unn mein say aksar mushrik thay .
lehaza tum apna rukh sahih deen ki taraf qaeem rakho , qabal iss kay kay woh din aaye jiss kay talney ka Allah ki taraf say koi imkan nahi hai . uss din log alag alag hojayen gay .
jiss ney kufr kiya hai , uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga , aur jinn logon  ney naik amal kiya hai , woh apney liye hi raasta bana rahey hain ,
nateeja yeh kay Allah unn logon  ko apney fazal say jaza dey ga jo emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain . yaqeenan Allah kafiron ko pasand nahi kerta .

aur uss ( Allah ki qudrat ) ki aik nishani yeh hai kay woh hawayen bhejta hai jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur iss liye bhejta hai takay tumhen apni rehmat ka kuch maza chakhaye , aur takay kashtiyan uss kay hukum say paani mein chalen , aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur shukar ada kero .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay bhi boht say payghumber unn ki qoamon kay paas bhejay , chunacheh woh unn kay paas khulay khulay dalaeel ley ker aaye . phir jinhon ney jaraeem ka irtikab kiya tha , hum ney unn say intiqam liya , aur hum ney yeh zimma daari li thi kay emaan walon ki madad keren .

Allah hi woh hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , chunacheh woh badal ko uthati hain , phir woh uss ( badal ) ko jiss tarah chahta hai , aasman mein phela deta hai , aur ussay kaee tehon ( wali ghata ) mein tabdeel ker deta hai . tab tum dekhtay ho kay uss kay darmiyan say barish baras rahi hai . chunacheh jab woh apney bandon mein say jinn ko chahta hai , woh barish phonchata hai to woh achanak khushi mananey lagtay hain ,
halankay iss say pehlay jab tak unn per barish nahi barsai gaee thi , woh na-umeed horahey thay .

abb zara Allah ki rehmat kay asraat dekho kay woh zameen ko uss kay murda honey kay baad kiss tarah zindagi bakhshta hai ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh murdon ko zinda kernay wala hai , aur woh her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
aur agar hum ( nuqsan deh ) hawa chala den   jiss kay nateejay mein woh apney khet ko peela parra huwa dekhen to uss kay baad yeh nashukri kernay lagen .
gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) tum murdon ko apni baat nahi suna saktay , aur naa behron ko apni pukar suna saktay ho jab woh peeth pher ker jarahey hon ,
aur naa tum andhon ko unn ki gumrahi say nikal ker raastay per daal saktay ho .   tum to unhi logon  ko apni baat suna saktay ho jo humari aayaton per emaan layen , phir farmanbardaar ban jayen .

Allah woh hai jiss ney tumhari takhleeq ki ibtida kamzori say ki , phir kamzori kay baad taqat ata farmaee , phir taqat kay baad ( dobara ) kamzori aur burhapa taari kerdiya . woh jo chahta hai , peda kerta hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , qudrat bhi kamil .
aur jiss din qayamat barpa hogi , uss din mujrim log qasam kha len gay kay woh ( barzakh mein ) aik gharri say ziyada nahi rahey . issi tarah ( duniya mein bhi ) woh ondhay chala kertay thay .

jinn logon  ko ilm aur emaan ata kiya gaya hai , woh kahen gay kay :  tum Allah ki likhi hoi taqdeer kay mutabiq hashar kay din tak ( barzakh mein ) parray rahey ho . abb yeh wohi hashar ka din hai , lekin tum log yaqeen nahi kertay thay .
chunacheh jinn logon  ney zulm ki raah apnai thi , uss din unn ki maazrat unhen koi faeeda nahi phonchaye gi , aur naa unn say yeh kaha jaye ga kay Allah ki narazi door kero .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss Quran mein logon  ( ko samjhaney ) ki khatir her qisam ki baaten biyan ki hain . aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ka haal yeh hai kay tum inn kay paas koi bhi nishani ley aao , yeh kafir log phir bhi yehi kahen gay kay tum kuch bhi nahi , bilkul ghalat kaar ho .
Allah issi tarah unn logon  kay dilon per thappa laga deta hai jo samajh say kaam nahi letay .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum sabar say kaam lo , yaqeen jano Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur aisa hergiz naa hona chahiye kay jo log yaqeen nahi kertay , unn ki wajeh say tum dhelay parr-jao .
